verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop coding-agent app, but the evidence never mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any setting to disable them. The Settings items shown cover updates, skills and MCP servers, and the --password-store flag only chooses a credential store, so none of these address telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
